description_en: A single document of identification and verification of persons with disabilities for availing various benefits.
description_ml: വിവിധ ആനുകൂല്യങ്ങൾ ലഭിക്കുന്നതിന് ഭിന്നശേഷിക്കാർക്കുള്ള തിരിച്ചറിയൽ കാർഡ്.

source.document_title: Guidelines for the Issuance of Unique Disability Identity (UDID) Card
source.issuing_authority: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: You must be a citizen of India.
eligibility_criteria.citation: udid_guideline.md, Section 2, Clause 2.1, "The applicant must be a citizen of India."

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: You must have a disability of at least 40%.
eligibility_criteria.citation: udid_guideline.md, Section 2, Clause 2.2, "The applicant must have a benchmark disability of at least [TO VERIFY] 40% as certified by a competent medical authority."

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: The severity must be verified by a medical authority.
eligibility_criteria.citation: udid_guideline.md, Section 2, Clause 2.4, "The severity of the disability must be verified and confirmed as genuine by the competent medical authority based on their clinical assessment."

required_documents.name_en: Aadhaar Card or valid Identity Proof

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted exclusively through the centralized online portal: Swavlamban Card Portal (www.swavlambancard.gov.in). Citation: udid_guideline.md, Section 5.

name_en: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS) - Kerala
description_en: Monthly financial assistance for persons with severe or multiple disabilities from BPL families.
description_ml: ബിപിഎൽ കുടുംബങ്ങളിലെ കഠിനമായ ഭിന്നശേഷിയുള്ളവർക്ക് പ്രതിമാസ ധനസഹായം.

source.document_title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS) - Kerala Implementation
source.issuing_authority: Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: You must be a resident of Kerala.
eligibility_criteria.citation: kerala_pension_guideline.md, Section 2, Clause 2.1, "The applicant must be a permanent resident of Kerala."

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: Your age must be between 18 and 79 years.
eligibility_criteria.citation: kerala_pension_guideline.md, Section 2, Clause 2.2, "The applicant must be in the age group of [TO VERIFY] 18 to [TO VERIFY] 79 years."

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: You must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household.
eligibility_criteria.citation: kerala_pension_guideline.md, Section 2, Clause 2.3, "The applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household."

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: You must have a severe disability of at least 80% or multiple disabilities.
eligibility_criteria.explanation_ml: നിങ്ങൾക്ക് കുറഞ്ഞത് 80% വൈകല്യമോ ഒന്നിലധികം വൈകല്യങ്ങളോ ഉണ്ടായിരിക്കണം.
eligibility_criteria.citation: kerala_pension_guideline.md, Section 2, Clause 2.4, "The applicant must have a severe disability of at least [TO VERIFY] 80% or multiple disabilities."

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: You must not be receiving other substantial financial assistance.
eligibility_criteria.explanation_ml: സർക്കാരിൽ നിന്ന് മറ്റ് പെൻഷനുകൾ ലഭിക്കാൻ പാടില്ല.
eligibility_criteria.citation: kerala_pension_guideline.md, Section 2, Clause 2.5, "The applicant must not be receiving any other substantial financial assistance from state or central government, as determined by the welfare officer."

how_to_apply: Submit to the Secretary of the respective Grama Panchayat, Municipality, or Municipal Corporation. Citation: kerala_pension_guideline.md, Section 5.

name_en: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids/Appliances (ADIP)
description_en: Assists disabled persons in procuring scientifically manufactured, modern, standard aids and appliances.
description_ml: ഭിന്നശേഷിക്കാർക്ക് ആധുനിക സഹായ ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ നൽകുന്ന പദ്ധതി.
benefit: Full or partial cost of assistive devices like wheelchairs and hearing aids.

source.document_title: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids/Appliances (ADIP) Scheme
source.issuing_authority: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: You must be an Indian citizen.
eligibility_criteria.citation: adip_guideline.md, Section 2, Clause 2.1, "Must be an Indian citizen of any age."

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: You must have a disability of at least 40%.
eligibility_criteria.citation: adip_guideline.md, Section 2, Clause 2.2, "Must possess a 40% [TO VERIFY] disability certificate."

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: Your monthly income must not exceed Rs. 22,500.
eligibility_criteria.explanation_ml: നിങ്ങളുടെ പ്രതിമാസ വരുമാനം 22,500 രൂപയിൽ കവിയാൻ പാടില്ല.
eligibility_criteria.citation: adip_guideline.md, Section 2, Clause 2.3, "Monthly income from all sources must not exceed Rs. [TO VERIFY] 22,500."

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: You must not have received this assistance in the last 3 years.
eligibility_criteria.explanation_ml: കഴിഞ്ഞ 3 വർഷത്തിനുള്ളിൽ നിങ്ങൾ ഈ സഹായം കൈപ്പറ്റിയിരിക്കരുത്.
eligibility_criteria.citation: adip_guideline.md, Section 2, Clause 2.4, "Must not have received assistance during the last [TO VERIFY] 3 years for the same purpose from any source"

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: The device must be deemed essential by an authority.
eligibility_criteria.citation: adip_guideline.md, Section 2, Clause 2.5, "The prescribed assistive device must be deemed absolutely essential for the daily functioning of the individual by the recommending authority."

how_to_apply: Applications can be made at designated camps organized by ALIMCO or via the ADIP portal. Citation: adip_guideline.md, Section 5.

description_en: Financial assistance for students with disabilities pursuing education from Class 9 onwards.
description_ml: ഒമ്പതാം ക്ലാസ് മുതൽ പഠിക്കുന്ന ഭിന്നശേഷിക്കാരായ വിദ്യാർത്ഥികൾക്ക് സാമ്പത്തിക സഹായം.
benefit: Maintenance and book allowances (Rs. 500 - 1200 per month).

source.document_title: Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarships for Students with Disabilities
source.issuing_authority: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD)

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: You must be an Indian national.
eligibility_criteria.citation: scholarship_guideline.md, Section 2, Clause 2.1, "The student must be an Indian national."

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: You must have a disability of at least 40%.
eligibility_criteria.citation: scholarship_guideline.md, Section 2, Clause 2.2, "The student must have a benchmark disability of [TO VERIFY] 40% or more."

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: Your family's annual income must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000.
eligibility_criteria.citation: scholarship_guideline.md, Section 2, Clauses 2.3 & 2.4, "the student's parents'/guardians' annual income must not exceed Rs. [TO VERIFY] 2,50,000."

eligibility_criteria.explanation_en: You must maintain satisfactory academic progress.
eligibility_criteria.citation: scholarship_guideline.md, Section 2, Clause 2.5, "The student must maintain satisfactory academic progress and good conduct, as certified by the head of the institution."

how_to_apply: All applications must be routed through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). Citation: scholarship_guideline.md, Section 5.
